description: lib/json.fz type_name/1 (used in the 'protocol JSON.Encoder not implemented for ...' and String.Chars refusals) names Tuple, PID, Reference and otherwise falls through to "Function", so a struct without a derive, a resource or any other value is reported as a Function. Elixir names the struct module (e.g. 'protocol JSON.Encoder not implemented for Outer.Inner (a struct)') and 'Function' only for a function. Make the fallback name the value's actual type for every value kind, with oracle fixtures for a struct and a function on all three paths.
title: JSON.Encoder's refusal names the value's type as Elixir does
